closed_ontology.authority: only enumerated products/processes/facts/identity requirements plus neutral typed slots; no unplanned substantive claims
closed_ontology.unlisted_concept_or_uncertain_relation: U and pre-score independent adjudication; never implicit0

fact_semantics.water_pressure: Measured gauge water pressure; no hydraulic-head proxy unless explicitly converted and recorded as pressure.
fact_semantics.remaining_capacity: Measured retained usable electrical capacity; query does not prescribe units. No remaining energy or state-of-charge substitute.
fact_semantics.flight_height_above_local_ground: Radar-derived bird height relative to local terrain, not altitude above sea level without terrain conversion.
fact_semantics.observed_nighttime_radar_tracking: Actual migration observations from radar radio echoes, not radio-tag telemetry or simulation; night sampling explicit.
fact_semantics.observed_wheelchair_access_audit: Public road bus stops and wheelchair access explicit; taxi/tram/rail not equivalent.
fact_semantics.electricity_consumption: Integrated electrical energy used over treatment, not instantaneous power alone.
fact_semantics.sound_pressure_level_db: Measured sound pressure level in decibels, not acoustic intensity/power or subjective annoyance alone.
fact_semantics.air_temperature: Observed shade-associated AIR temperature for urban STREET TREES. No cooling/reduction or causal comparison required; roadside vegetation without tree evidence is insufficient.
fact_semantics.per_reading_clock_time: Row-associated individual clock timestamp for EACH air-temperature measurement. Publication/release year/month or broad coverage date is NOT this fact; shade association is observational, no causal cooling/reduction required.
fact_semantics.per_passage_clock_time: Row-associated individual clock timestamp for EACH radar passage observation, with nighttime explicit. Publication/release year/month, generic nighttime coverage, or broad collection period is NOT this fact.
fact_semantics.electric_vehicle_battery_cells: Individual rechargeable electrochemical CELLS intended for electric vehicles, not car-only, not entire battery packs; may serve any road EV class. No vehicle subtype restriction.

budgets.counting: Unicode whitespace-delimited tokens in dataset description; natural informational context only

evidence_layouts.root_measurements: All canonical measurement facts documented in dataset description; nested title/description names file/format/collection only and MUST NOT state measurement facts independently. Product/process/basis explicit in primary metadata.
evidence_layouts.nested_measurements: Product/process/basis explicit in dataset metadata; all required measurement facts ONLY in the first published authorized nested distribution title/description; dataset fields do not enumerate them. Projection remains actual title+description, no injection.
evidence_layouts.exact_scope: Apply identity_scope plus required_exact_title; no extra semantic claims.
evidence_layouts.format_evidence: Every declared format has an actual corresponding schema-valid downloadable distribution; no undisclosed PDF/other formats.

identity_scope_rules.distribution_only: Identity string and any analyzer-equivalent normalized alias occur only inside permitted nested distribution title/description, absent from dataset title/description/keywords/publisher/queryContext/root embedding. Dataset structural IDs never contain item identity.
identity_scope_rules.distribution_only_identifier_exact_title: Same distribution-only identifier policy; separately required exact dataset title contains no item code.
identity_scope_rules.title_only_primary_fields: Identity confined to title among primary fields, forbidden in description/keywords/publisher/distributions; production-derived title+description queryContext and embedding naturally retain title identity. Never redact projection.
identity_scope_rules.primary_identity: Identity in title; description may naturally restate at most once; no other record asserts this item as its identity.
identity_scope_rules.exact_title: Exact required title enforced; version lookalikes are different authoritative identities.
identity_scope_rules.component_reference_policy: Component labels MAY contain registered parent base tokens only in required component title/identity, never claim to be parent unit. Full exact targets remain objective IDs even if analyzers conflate base codes.

growth.nested_subset_rule: Level1000 is exact byte-identical subset of level2000 within seed; core identical at every level. No duplicate dataset IDs.
growth.diversity_limitation: 20 semantic archetypes, 60 archetype×seed prose classes, not1940 independent relevance populations.

growth_declarative_grammar.stage: Structural/semantic grammar frozen now; no searchable sentence terminals are authored by architect. B first realizes one complete field bundle/archetype/seed (60) with placeholders, C audits actual searchable text, then main freezes these immutable terminal bundles BEFORE expanding replica rows or any embedding/search. This is first-realization content audit, not an adaptive design change.
growth_declarative_grammar.semantic_atoms: Exactly canonical claim_set product/process/basis/facts and no not_documented_facts; full searchable fields rendered once/style/archetype, no dynamic prose callbacks.

site_code.placement: publisher.name and one natural provenance clause only

year.placement: Explicit metadata PUBLICATION/RELEASE date clause only; never collection/observation/measurement date or individual row timestamp.

month.placement: Explicit metadata PUBLICATION/RELEASE date clause only; never collection/observation/measurement date or individual row timestamp.

distribution_format.rule: Exactly two distributions for every growth row: CSV first, JSON second, identical canonical content and no new claims. No optional format combination.

growth_declarative_grammar.reconstruction: C independently parses frozen terminal bundles and typed slots (no B-code import), reconstructs every searchable field and production queryContext for EVERY row/seed and compares exact bytes. Any mismatch/extra field/unsupported slot is fail, not sampling.
growth_declarative_grammar.independent_manual_scope: Review ALL60 realized core records/seed=180 plus ALL60 full growth field-bundle classes; quote evidence for each fact and exclusions. Every growth row then verified by independent exact reconstruction + type/domain checks. Do not claim6000 independent manual judgments.
growth_declarative_grammar.record_identification: Internal IDs outside indexed text; titles cannot embed archetype/tier/replica codes. Neutral collection date may appear naturally. Separate sites are declared synthetic collection panels, not falsely claimed substantive diversity.
growth_declarative_grammar.neutral_date_not_measurement_evidence: Year/month slots refer ONLY to metadata publication/release; never use collected/sampled/observed wording for these slots. Cannot add per_reading_clock_time/per_passage_clock_time to g10/g12 or other records omitting these facts. C audits full cross-field combinations and every row reconstruction.

seed_variation.variation_audit: C records wording/field-order/content-context differences, discloses low variation; no score-based acceptance.

grade_expansion.core: Lookup EVERY key explicitly in planned_core_intent_doc_grades.
grade_expansion.growth: Parse exact ID into gNN and rMMM, validate frozen level membership, lookup EVERY intent×gNN key explicitly in planned_growth_intent_archetype_grades. Replicas inherit canonical grade by proven exact reconstruction only.
grade_expansion.query: Every query uses its frozen intent_id map after independent paraphrase audit.
grade_expansion.ambiguous: AllU deliberately ungraded; exclude from all numeric FP/relevance metrics.
grade_expansion.zero_negative: 0 is PLANNED design truth until exhaustive actual-text absence audit. Uncertainty=>U and D, never optimistic0.

implementation_constraints.derived_query_context: Actual pinned production title+description projection at dataset/distribution scope; no role/label or extra synonym injection.
implementation_constraints.model_mapping_runtime: Reuse inherited actual production embedding/mapping pipeline and hash exact artifacts; no new model/dimension choice.

fixed_score_diagnostic_pairs_metadata.purpose: Complete fixed pair population, not retrieved-top10 selection
fixed_score_diagnostic_pairs_metadata.seed_expansion: Use all72 listed tuples in EACH frozen seed, same vectors at every size
fixed_score_diagnostic_pairs_metadata.opportunity_evidence_scope_rule: Root/nested evidence-bearing opportunity minimum counts only when THAT measurement-bearing scope has native vector score in[.45,.50); an unrelated branch score does not satisfy that scope minimum.
fixed_score_diagnostic_pairs_metadata.native_score_diagnostic: All72 pair branch scores from immutable production vectors, exact pair distance/native score conversion calibrated against engine; separate from final fusion and approximate nearest-neighbor rank.
fixed_score_diagnostic_pairs_metadata.keyword_diagnostic: Actual production keyword-only query-builder diagnostic with vectors absent; inspect full corpus matched-ID eligibility and analyzer outputs, not only top10. Primary hybrid DSL stays unchanged.

all_corpus_native_eligibility_diagnostic.population: ALL48 numerically scored NEW queries crossed with EVERY record at EACH60/1000/2000 level in EACH seed, with every authorized nested projection; no result-pool selection. Ambiguity fragments may have membership diagnostics but never numeric grade0 counts.
all_corpus_native_eligibility_diagnostic.systems: Only the seven frozen thresholds and fixed branch diagnostic pairs, no new candidate grid.
all_corpus_native_eligibility_diagnostic.timing: Immutable audited corpus/qrels/vectors first; heldout diagnostics only AFTER persisted DEV choice record.
all_corpus_native_eligibility_diagnostic.method: Actual production keyword-only full matched-ID eligibility plus calibrated native root/nested scores from immutable production vectors and exact same scope filters. Eligibility is separate from actual approximate engine retrieval and final topK rank exposure.
all_corpus_native_eligibility_diagnostic.report: For every threshold report newly vector-eligible grade0 IDs absent vector eligibility at.50, separately root/nested/union; subset with keyword eligibility FALSE (new vector-only noise), keyword TRUE (overlap), full corpus counts and observed top5/top10 membership. Also report keyword-eligible IDs newly promoted into topK even when vector eligibility was not new. Report all absolute baseline/candidate grade0 topK totals separately.
all_corpus_native_eligibility_diagnostic.gate_attribution: Safety counts NEW topK grade0 ID exposures vs baseline topK, NOT only new vector-only eligibility. A previously keyword-eligible ID newly entering topK still counts; unchanged preexisting keyword-OR hits do not become new threshold costs.
all_corpus_native_eligibility_diagnostic.opportunity_population_unchanged: The separate72 frozen useful-positive pairs alone define preregistered opportunity quotas; full-corpus diagnostics neither expand that population adaptively nor create candidates.

neutral_metadata_policy.scope: EXACTLY ALL60 core and ALL growth rows, ALL3 seeds, ALL3 catalog sizes and every primary/diagnostic configuration; no generation profile confounding.

dataset.temporal: ABSENT; row-associated measurement clock evidence is textual only; neutral publication dates are not observation coverage.

distribution.quality: NOT A DISTRIBUTION FIELD; do not invent
distribution.hasQuality: NOT A DISTRIBUTION FIELD; do not invent

neutral_metadata_policy.quality_spatial_authorization_stress: Only separately registered inherited correctness/security fixtures, never mixed into main NEW relevance corpus or primary qrels; no NEW stress records generated by this design.
neutral_metadata_policy.C_validation: Check exact actual fixture values/absence at dataset AND nested scope for EVERY row, plus full terminal reconstruction. No false assertion of neutral semantics from merely missing validation.
neutral_metadata_policy.structural_grammar_fields: Include these fixed nontext neutral fields in EVERY independently reconstructed whole metadata row, beyond the ordered searchable text fields.
